then.text: Same cheese, two names. Andreas says his squeaks louder. Let him. Afiyet olsun: enjoy your meal.
You've tasted mine. Now you know. Go and tell the experts, and take your time, they'll agree with me.
Hoş geldiniz, welcome, judge. Hellim: sheep and goat, a little mint, kept in salty whey in a jar, the way my grandmother did in this village, and hers before her.
Fry it in a pan with tomato and a bit of bread. Andreas puts his on the grill. He is wrong, but he is my neighbour.

else.text: Merhaba! Hello. Turkish coffee? Say 'orta' for medium sweet, 'sade' for plain. Leave the grounds.
Andreas over the square calls it Cypriot coffee. He's been wrong since we were boys, and I've told him every morning.

pyl_cards.text: We play pişti here, a card game. Andreas's men play prefa. Different games, same complaint about the cards.
